name: USDJPY NFP Reaction: Beat vs Miss × VIX Regime
description: How does USD/JPY move after NFP releases conditioned on both surprise direction (beat vs miss) and VIX regime (low <20 vs high >=20)? Beat/miss defined as MoM payroll change above/below its trailing 6-month average. VIX regime uses closing VIX level on NFP day with threshold at 20. Forward returns measured at 1d, 3d, 5d, 10d, 20d horizons across four groups: Beat+LowVIX, Beat+HighVIX, Miss+LowVIX, Miss+HighVIX. Outputs: median return path from Day 0 to Day 20 showing how the USD/JPY drift evolves per group, grouped bar chart of median returns by horizon and group, event markers with beat/miss and VIX regime labels, and a stats table with N, median, hit rate per group.
source:
# USDJPY NFP Reaction: Beat vs Miss × VIX Regime
# Beat = MoM payroll change > trailing 6-month avg, Miss = below
# VIX regime: Low (<20) vs High (>=20) at time of NFP release
# Forward returns: 1d, 3d, 5d, 10d, 20d after NFP announcement

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
ts = index().value

# --- VIX data (shared context, ffill for calendar alignment) ---
vix = common_indices(ticker=ReferenceIndex.VIX)()
vix_close = ffill(vix.c)

# --- NFP Calendar (exact announcement dates) ---
nfp_cal = economic_calendar(source=CalendarSource.FRED, release_id=50)()
is_nfp = nfp_cal.is_released

# --- PAYEMS data for surprise classification ---
nfp_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='PAYEMS')()
nfp_val = ffill(nfp_raw.result)

# MoM change in payrolls (thousands) — computed on observation dates
had_nfp_obs = is_valid(nfp_raw.result)
mom_change = nfp_raw.result - valuewhen(occurrence=1)(had_nfp_obs, nfp_raw.result)

# Trailing 6-month average of MoM changes (S34 sparse MA pattern)
chg_1 = valuewhen(occurrence=1)(had_nfp_obs, mom_change)
chg_2 = valuewhen(occurrence=2)(had_nfp_obs, mom_change)
chg_3 = valuewhen(occurrence=3)(had_nfp_obs, mom_change)
chg_4 = valuewhen(occurrence=4)(had_nfp_obs, mom_change)
chg_5 = valuewhen(occurrence=5)(had_nfp_obs, mom_change)
trailing_6m_avg = (mom_change + chg_1 + chg_2 + chg_3 + chg_4 + chg_5) / 6

# ffill both so they're available on announcement dates
mom_change_ff = ffill(mom_change)
trailing_avg_ff = ffill(trailing_6m_avg)

# --- Classify: beat/miss × VIX regime on NFP day ---
is_beat = is_nfp and is_valid(mom_change_ff) and mom_change_ff > trailing_avg_ff
is_miss = is_nfp and is_valid(mom_change_ff) and mom_change_ff <= trailing_avg_ff
is_low_vix = is_valid(vix_close) and vix_close < 20
is_high_vix = is_valid(vix_close) and vix_close >= 20

# Four groups
is_beat_low = is_beat and is_low_vix
is_beat_high = is_beat and is_high_vix
is_miss_low = is_miss and is_low_vix
is_miss_high = is_miss and is_high_vix

# --- Forward Returns (on USDJPY price) ---
fwd_1d = forward_returns(period=1)(close)
fwd_3d = forward_returns(period=3)(close)
fwd_5d = forward_returns(period=5)(close)
fwd_10d = forward_returns(period=10)(close)
fwd_20d = forward_returns(period=20)(close)

# --- Filter by 4 groups ---
bl_1d = where(is_beat_low, fwd_1d)
bl_3d = where(is_beat_low, fwd_3d)
bl_5d = where(is_beat_low, fwd_5d)
bl_10d = where(is_beat_low, fwd_10d)
bl_20d = where(is_beat_low, fwd_20d)

bh_1d = where(is_beat_high, fwd_1d)
bh_3d = where(is_beat_high, fwd_3d)
bh_5d = where(is_beat_high, fwd_5d)
bh_10d = where(is_beat_high, fwd_10d)
bh_20d = where(is_beat_high, fwd_20d)

ml_1d = where(is_miss_low, fwd_1d)
ml_3d = where(is_miss_low, fwd_3d)
ml_5d = where(is_miss_low, fwd_5d)
ml_10d = where(is_miss_low, fwd_10d)
ml_20d = where(is_miss_low, fwd_20d)

mh_1d = where(is_miss_high, fwd_1d)
mh_3d = where(is_miss_high, fwd_3d)
mh_5d = where(is_miss_high, fwd_5d)
mh_10d = where(is_miss_high, fwd_10d)
mh_20d = where(is_miss_high, fwd_20d)

# --- Hit rates (% positive USDJPY return = USD strengthened) ---
bl_hit_1d = 1.0 if (is_valid(bl_1d) and bl_1d > 0) else 0.0
bl_hit_3d = 1.0 if (is_valid(bl_3d) and bl_3d > 0) else 0.0
bl_hit_5d = 1.0 if (is_valid(bl_5d) and bl_5d > 0) else 0.0
bl_hit_10d = 1.0 if (is_valid(bl_10d) and bl_10d > 0) else 0.0
bl_hit_20d = 1.0 if (is_valid(bl_20d) and bl_20d > 0) else 0.0

bh_hit_1d = 1.0 if (is_valid(bh_1d) and bh_1d > 0) else 0.0
bh_hit_3d = 1.0 if (is_valid(bh_3d) and bh_3d > 0) else 0.0
bh_hit_5d = 1.0 if (is_valid(bh_5d) and bh_5d > 0) else 0.0
bh_hit_10d = 1.0 if (is_valid(bh_10d) and bh_10d > 0) else 0.0
bh_hit_20d = 1.0 if (is_valid(bh_20d) and bh_20d > 0) else 0.0

ml_hit_1d = 1.0 if (is_valid(ml_1d) and ml_1d > 0) else 0.0
ml_hit_3d = 1.0 if (is_valid(ml_3d) and ml_3d > 0) else 0.0
ml_hit_5d = 1.0 if (is_valid(ml_5d) and ml_5d > 0) else 0.0
ml_hit_10d = 1.0 if (is_valid(ml_10d) and ml_10d > 0) else 0.0
ml_hit_20d = 1.0 if (is_valid(ml_20d) and ml_20d > 0) else 0.0

mh_hit_1d = 1.0 if (is_valid(mh_1d) and mh_1d > 0) else 0.0
mh_hit_3d = 1.0 if (is_valid(mh_3d) and mh_3d > 0) else 0.0
mh_hit_5d = 1.0 if (is_valid(mh_5d) and mh_5d > 0) else 0.0
mh_hit_10d = 1.0 if (is_valid(mh_10d) and mh_10d > 0) else 0.0
mh_hit_20d = 1.0 if (is_valid(mh_20d) and mh_20d > 0) else 0.0

# --- Day 0 anchors (zero return at NFP release) for return path chart ---
bl_0d = where(is_beat_low, 0.0)
bh_0d = where(is_beat_high, 0.0)
ml_0d = where(is_miss_low, 0.0)
mh_0d = where(is_miss_high, 0.0)

# --- CONTEXT: Cumulative return paths from Day 0 to Day 20 ---
labeled_lines(
    title='How Does USD/JPY Drift After NFP? Median Path by Group',
    category='NFP × VIX',
    x_axis_label='Days After NFP',
    y_axis_label='Median USDJPY Return',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    data_labels=True,
    smooth=True,
    order=0,
    series=LabeledLineSeriesSchema(
        x_labels=['Day 0', 'Day 1', 'Day 3', 'Day 5', 'Day 10', 'Day 20'],
        series=[
            LabeledLineSeriesSpec(name='Beat+LowVIX', color=Color.Blue, agg=AggregationType.Median, marker=MarkerSymbol.CircleMarker),
            LabeledLineSeriesSpec(name='Beat+HighVIX', color=Color.Cyan, agg=AggregationType.Median, marker=MarkerSymbol.DiamondMarker),
            LabeledLineSeriesSpec(name='Miss+LowVIX', color=Color.Slate, agg=AggregationType.Median, marker=MarkerSymbol.SquareMarker),
            LabeledLineSeriesSpec(name='Miss+HighVIX', color=Color.Red, agg=AggregationType.Median, marker=MarkerSymbol.TriangleMarker)
        ]
    ),
    y_reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ])
)(bl_0d, bl_1d, bl_3d, bl_5d, bl_10d, bl_20d,
  bh_0d, bh_1d, bh_3d, bh_5d, bh_10d, bh_20d,
  ml_0d, ml_1d, ml_3d, ml_5d, ml_10d, ml_20d,
  mh_0d, mh_1d, mh_3d, mh_5d, mh_10d, mh_20d)

# --- PUNCHLINE: Median forward returns by horizon, 4 groups ---
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.series,

    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=1
)(bl_1d, bl_3d, bl_5d, bl_10d, bl_20d,
  bh_1d, bh_3d, bh_5d, bh_10d, bh_20d,

# --- REFERENCE: Stats table (20 rows × 3 cols: N, Median, Hit Rate) ---
